records.subject: Confirming cancellation for Quartz Group
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for Quartz Group -- the door's open if that changes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Re: The mobile save button
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for the note about the mobile save button -- looking into it now, will follow up soon.

The mobile view cuts off the save button on smaller screens, making it impossible to save changes.

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Group!
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone despite welcome email [email:cd3d0214]. Only customer-initiated contact is a blocking bug ticket (tick_d33977f041dc) still open per [email:cafc7bb0], which can deter further setup. No sign of self-serve momentum; 8 days left.

draft.subject: Following up on your mobile save button ticket
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for flagging the mobile save button cutting off on smaller screens — that ticket is still open with Tariq, and he'll follow up as soon as he has news.

In the meantime, I'd like to make sure Wrenfield is useful for Quartz Group. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting a first project in place is usually the best starting point. Would a short call this week work? I can walk through it with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
